desc:
🏰 Build an OP Army! 🏰

Every match starts with an auction. You and your rival take turns bidding on units from a pool of 90+ fighters, from humble swordsmen all the way up to Mythic dragons. Your wallet is tiny, so every dollar counts!

When the bidding ends, the armies clash in the arena… and you're right there on the battlefield with them!

━━━ HOW IT PLAYS ━━━
🔨 Bid on units in a fast 1v1 auction
🧠 Plan your army: tanks up front, archers and mages behind
⚔️ Swing your weapon and fight alongside your troops
🌋 Turn the tide with spells: meteors, blizzards, even a dragon strike!
🏆 Last army standing wins

━━━ COLLECT & UPGRADE ━━━
📦 Crack open crates for new spells and weapons
💎 Hunt for Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic units
🗡️ Unlock 24 weapons, from simple swords to the Banhammer

━━━ PARTY MODE ━━━
🎉 3 to 6 players, one auction, total chaos

One giant unit or a swarm of little ones? Every draft is a new gamble! 🎲

🔔 Hit Favorite so you don't miss
